common.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select the text and copy it.

security.allowInsecureHint: Not encrypted. Use only on a trusted network when the server can’t use HTTPS.
security.confirmDescription: Credentials and synced data will cross the network unencrypted, where others on the network can read or change them. Turn this on only for a server on a trusted network that can’t use HTTPS. The change is recorded in the audit log.

direction.pullHint: Changes made in {system} are copied into IS Big Platform. Edits in IS Big Platform stay in IS Big Platform.
direction.pushHint: Changes made in IS Big Platform are sent to {system}. Edits in {system} are not copied back.
direction.bothHint: Changes on either side reach the other. When both change the same field, the conflict rule decides.

policy.manualHint: Both values stay as they are and the conflict waits in the conflicts list. Other fields still sync.
policy.remoteHint: The value from {system} overwrites the one in IS Big Platform.
policy.localHint: The value from IS Big Platform is sent to {system}.
policy.newestHint: The side whose record was changed last wins.

overview.title: Integrations
overview.description: Connections to outside systems and what syncs between them and IS Big Platform.
overview.emptyHint: Add a connection to an outside system, then set up what syncs with it.
overview.unavailable: Its connector module is not available.
overview.pickDescription: Choose the kind of system to connect to.
overview.noConnectors: No connector is installed. Connector modules (such as ServiceDesk Plus or Azure DevOps) add systems you can connect to.

connectionForm.description: Settings of the outside system and the credentials IS Big Platform uses.
connectionForm.name: Connection name
connectionForm.nameHint: Shown in lists, run logs and on synced records.
connectionForm.unavailable: The connector of this connection is not available, so its settings can’t be edited.
connectionForm.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
connectionForm.secretRemoved: Will be removed when you save.
connectionForm.enabledHint: When off, nothing syncs and webhook calls are refused.
connectionForm.insecureHint: If the server can’t use HTTPS, turn on “Allow insecure HTTP” under Security.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: The outside system calls this address when records change; IS Big Platform then reads them. Polling continues as a safety net.
webhook.notSupported: This connector doesn’t use webhooks; changes are read on the schedule.
webhook.rotateDescription: A new secret is created and shown once. The outside system’s webhook stops working until you enter the new secret there.
webhook.secretDescription: Enter this secret in the outside system’s webhook settings.
webhook.once: This is the only time the secret is shown. Copy it now.

hints.generic: Send the secret in the X-ISBP-Webhook-Secret header, or as the password of HTTP Basic authentication (any user name). The webhook only says which records changed.
hints.sdp_cloud: In ServiceDesk Plus Cloud: Admin → Automation → Webhooks. Add a custom header X-ISBP-Webhook-Secret with the secret and call the webhook from the business rules of requests, problems, changes and assets.
hints.sdp_server: In ServiceDesk Plus: Admin → Automation → Custom Triggers or Webhooks. Add a custom header X-ISBP-Webhook-Secret with the secret.
hints.azdo_server: In Azure DevOps Server: Project settings → Service hooks → Web Hooks. Choose the work item and Git events, enter the URL and add the HTTP header X-ISBP-Webhook-Secret:secret.

connection.healthHint: Checked by tests, every 15 minutes, and by every sync.
connection.deleteDescription: Its sync rules, links, runs and conflicts are deleted. No record is deleted, in IS Big Platform or in the outside system.

profiles.emptyHint: A sync rule says what syncs with what: a kind of remote record with a kind of IS Big Platform record, and how fields map.
profiles.linked: {count, plural, one {# linked record} other {{n} linked records}}

editor.readOnly: You can see this rule but not change it: changing it needs the sync permission of its kind of record.
editor.whatHint: Choose a kind of record in the outside system and the kind of IS Big Platform record it becomes.
editor.whatFixed: These can’t change after the rule is created. Create another rule instead.
editor.name: Rule name
editor.scopeRequired: Choose where in the outside system.
editor.noSyncPermission: You don’t have the sync permission for this kind of record.
editor.containerRequired: Choose where in IS Big Platform.
editor.directionHint: Which way changes flow. Each field can narrow it further in the mapping.
editor.recordsHint: What happens to records that exist on only one side.
editor.createLocal: Create records in IS Big Platform
editor.createLocalHint: New records in {system} are created in IS Big Platform.
editor.createRemoteHint: New IS Big Platform records that pass the filter below are created in {system}.
editor.createRemoteUnsupported: {system} doesn’t let IS Big Platform create these records.
editor.matchRuleHint: Records both sides already have are linked instead of duplicated when this field has the same value.
editor.pushFilterHint: Only IS Big Platform records matching all conditions are created in {system}. No conditions: all of them.
editor.intervalHint: 0 turns scheduled syncs off (webhooks, Run now and Scheduled Jobs still work).
editor.intervalPush: Changes are pushed as soon as they happen in IS Big Platform.
editor.intervalInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1440.
editor.enabledHint: When off, nothing syncs for this rule.
editor.conflictsHint: When a field changed on both sides since the last sync.
editor.policyOneWay: With a one-way rule the source always wins: {system} for “Into IS Big Platform”, IS Big Platform for “Out of IS Big Platform”.
editor.commentsHint: New comments are copied both ways, each once, with their author. Internal notes stay internal in {system} too.
editor.commentsUnsupported: Comments can’t sync for this pair.
editor.mappingHint: Which IS Big Platform field matches which field in {system}. Values are converted (HTML ↔ Markdown, people by email, choices through value maps).
editor.mappingWaiting: Choose what syncs with what first.
editor.previewHint: A dry run on the next changes. Nothing is written and the sync position doesn’t move.
editor.deleteDescription: Its links, runs and conflicts are deleted; no record is deleted on either side. A new rule can link the records again.
editor.insecureHint: The server uses plain HTTP. If it can’t use HTTPS, turn on “Allow insecure HTTP” in the connection’s settings.
editor.errorsCount: {count, plural, one {# record didn’t sync} other {# records didn’t sync}}

mapping.localField: Field in IS Big Platform, row {n}
mapping.valuesDescription: Which IS Big Platform value each value from {system} becomes, and back.
mapping.valuesHint: One row per value and direction: several remote values can become the same IS Big Platform value with “Into IS Big Platform only” rows, and one row says what that IS Big Platform value becomes when it goes out. Values that are the same on both sides (ignoring case) need no row; a value without a match is skipped and logged.
mapping.addMissing: {count, plural, one {Add # value of {system}} other {Add # values of {system}}}

issues.unknown_local: IS Big Platform has no field “{field}”.
issues.unknown_remote: The remote system has no field “{field}”.
issues.incompatible: A {local} field can’t be mapped to a {remote} field.
issues.no_direction: Nothing can sync this way: a field is read-only, or the rule goes the other way.
issues.unknown_local_choice: “{value}” is not a choice in IS Big Platform.
issues.unknown_remote_choice: “{value}” is not a choice in the remote system.
issues.duplicate_value: “{value}” comes into IS Big Platform through two rows: make one of them “Out of IS Big Platform only”.
issues.required_unmapped: Map “{field}”: IS Big Platform needs it to create records.
issues.remote_required_unmapped: Map the remote field “{field}”: it’s needed to create records there.
issues.create_local_needs_pull: Creating records in IS Big Platform needs a rule that syncs into IS Big Platform.
issues.create_remote_needs_push: Creating remote records needs a rule that syncs out of IS Big Platform.
issues.create_unsupported: The remote system doesn’t let IS Big Platform create these records.
issues.comments_unsupported: Comments can’t sync for this pair.
issues.scope_required: Choose where in the remote system.
issues.container_required: Choose where in IS Big Platform.
issues.unknown_scope: Not found in the remote system.
issues.unknown_container: Not found, or you can’t see it.
issues.duplicate_local_value: “{value}” goes out of IS Big Platform through two rows: make one of them “Into IS Big Platform only”.
